intro: A back facial in Bali is one of the most underrated treatments on the island. Between surf sessions, sunscreen, sweat and humidity, the skin on your back, chest and glutes works harder than your face, yet it rarely gets professional care. At Point Face Bingin, in Uluwatu, we bring our Korean hydrodermabrasion technology to the body.
body_html:
What is a back facial?

A back facial is a professional deep-cleansing treatment for the back (and often the chest and shoulders). It follows the same logic as a facial: cleanse, exfoliate, extract, hydrate and protect. The difference is the surface area, and skin that is thicker, oilier and harder to reach on your own.

Why your back breaks out in Bali

  • Sweat + humidity: pores stay open and congested for hours.
  • Sunscreen and surf wax residue: heavy formulas and rash guards trap oil against the skin.
  • Salt water and sun: they dry the surface, so the skin produces more oil to compensate.
  • Tight swimwear and backpacks: friction irritates follicles on the shoulders and lower back.

The result: "bacne", blackheads between the shoulder blades, rough texture on the upper arms and uneven tone where tan lines meet.

Body hydrodermabrasion: how it works

Our body treatment uses the same hydrodermabrasion technology as our Korean Hydrafacials:

  1. Double cleanse to remove sunscreen, sweat and salt.
  2. Gentle exfoliation to lift dead skin.
  3. Hydrodermabrasion with vortex suction to clear pores without scrubbing.
  4. Extraction of blackheads where needed.
  5. Serum infusion and LED to calm and hydrate.
  6. Moisture + protection so you can go back to the beach.

It is non-invasive, there is no downtime, and most guests see smoother, clearer skin right after the session.

Back, chest and glutes: who is it for?

  • Surfers and active travellers with breakouts on the back or chest
  • Anyone preparing for a wedding, a photo shoot or a backless dress
  • Guests with rough, bumpy texture on the glutes or the back of the arms
  • Long-stay expats who want to keep body skin clear year-round

How often should you book?

For active breakouts, your therapist will recommend a short series of sessions after your skin analysis, then monthly maintenance. Before an event, book your last session 3 to 5 days ahead.

Where to get a back facial in Uluwatu

faq: Is a back facial the same as a Hydrafacial?
It uses the same hydrodermabrasion principle, adapted to the larger surface and thicker skin of the body.
Can I surf after a back facial?
Wait 24 hours before surfing or sunbathing, and wear SPF on the treated area.
Does a back facial help with bacne?
It deep-cleans pores and reduces congestion, which helps keep breakouts under control. Persistent or painful acne should be checked by a dermatologist.
Can men book a back facial?
Yes. Many of our body clients are male surfers.
